assets.purpose: 首次接触：插卡、转旋钮、揭开参考
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one exceptionally compelling functional desktop lesson-interface concept for a Chinese middle-school AI course, chapter 5, on a hands-on EXPERIMENT BENCH. Landscape 16:9. This is the first minutes of a lesson, so very few controls are visible. The student should immediately want to pick up a data card, turn a real-feeling knob, open a reference flap and test a prediction.
The entire screen is a CLOSE FIRST-PERSON view slightly down onto ONE coherent physical workbench, not a laboratory room, not a museum, not a forest and not a dashboard of floating cards. Bright comfortable daylight, off-white ceramic housings, precision machined graphite/aluminium rails, tactile rotary dials, brushed surfaces, clear glass, subtle realistic contact shadows, small natural green seedling teaching specimens. Restrained cobalt-blue prediction and amber reference colours. No cute robots, cartoons, anthropomorphic characters, steampunk, dark factory, neon sci-fi, fake AI brain, decorative equations, scores or badges. Rich precise material detail, inviting scientific curiosity.
Thin unobtrusive top bar: “NOVA 奇点” / “第五章 · 模型的学习” / “学习校准台”. A small task strip reads “实验 1 · 先试一张，再核对”.
CENTER of bench: a compact glass-topped prediction instrument seated firmly on the desktop with a left card slot, two large satisfying rotary knobs on the front, and a right measurement window. A physical teaching card labelled “光照 4 小时” is docked into the slot, with a small green specimen photo on the card. The model reads the numeric condition, not the photograph. The two knobs are labelled “w · 随输入增加” and “b · 整体抬高”, small correct readouts “0.70” and “1.20”. Inside the glass just a subtle cyan left-to-right signal route through two small arithmetic units, no huge formula panel.
RIGHT of instrument: a magnified vertical growth-increment measuring ruler with two visibly different fixed-height light pointers. Blue pointer exactly “预测 4.00”, amber pointer exactly “参考 5.10”; gap bracket exactly “相差 1.10 mm”. The amber reference is behind a beautiful hinged clear flap that is currently open; small tactile tab label “揭开参考”. Important scientific invariant: the green specimen and amber reference do NOT change when parameters turn; only the blue prediction changes. The plant photos are stable specimens, not plants being made to grow by AI.
LEFT/front of bench: a tidy shallow sample tray with six numbered realistic teaching cards, 1..6 once each, low visual weight. One next card near the front clearly labelled “光照 1 小时” invites trying another input. A small blank paper tab “我的猜测” sits nearby, plus a very small removable measuring note labelled “模拟温室教学数据”.
Two real-looking front-edge push buttons “试一次” and “复位”; a little tooltip close to the knobs “转动旋钮，观察蓝色预测”. Keep the opaque small task chrome at screen edges and dedicate at least 75% of the viewport to the accessible manipulative bench. No loss chart, timeline, contour bowl or large statistics panels in this introductory state. Do not add a marketing headline, slogans, a browser frame, full human hands, arbitrary formulas or extra gadgets. Show a beautifully finished educational experience that can be built with separate moving knobs, pointers, card trays and hinges. All requested Chinese labels clean and legible.

assets.purpose: 第三课：打开整组误差与单步学习回路
assets.prompt:
Edit the referenced lesson-interface image into a LATER STATE of the SAME experimental bench. Keep the camera, daylight, coherent desktop, ceramic/graphite/glass materials, original main prediction instrument, two knobs and their places, specimen tray, NOVA brand and restrained blue/amber colours. Keep all instruments physically grounded. This is chapter5 experiment3, with header “实验 3 · 让它自己调整”.
Now a slim forward-pull drawer has opened BELOW the instrument, revealing a small white/cobalt loss-landscape relief and six live residual strips, not a whole new world. Relief has one smooth convex diagonal trough, axes names “参数 w” and “参数 b”, no invented numeric ticks; a small probe and one short actual-update arrow, label “误差地形”. This is a visualisation of the two model parameters, never a geographic map or a gravity-driven ball.
The same docked card remains “光照 4 小时”. The fixed amber reference remains “5.10”. Show a paused state after ONE automatic batch learning step from initial w=0.70,b=1.20 at learning rate0.025. Current knob readouts are exactly w “0.9092”, b “1.2467”; current blue prediction ruler exactly “4.88”, amber reference exactly “5.10”, small gap exactly “0.22 mm”. A faint prior blue marker at4.00 can show where prediction used to be. Never change the actual specimen or amber target.
A small action lever on the front of the drawer reads “学习一步”, with a nearby “暂停” control and step-size dial labelled “步长 0.025”. Inside the transparent housing, a cyan forward path runs from input to prediction; an amber feedback path visibly aggregates all SIX residual strips and returns to both parameter dials. Make the causal chain visible and enticing, no meaningless decorative cables.
A very narrow transparent stage rail, readable and subordinate, shows “预测 → 整组误差 → 调整参数 → 再预测”. A short actual experiment ticket emerging from a small slot displays only “更新前 4.00”, “更新后 4.88”, “参考 5.10”, and “整组误差 1.17 → 0.064”. A blank area “我的解释” is for the learner, no prefilled conclusion.
Do not fill the screen with plots, formulas, cards or controls. Preserve the first-person experience of manipulating one familiar scientific device which has gradually unfolded. Every new object is a useful lab component. No robot, cartoon, steampunk, dramatic explosion, holographic clutter, decorative math, progress percentage or leaderboard. Same high-quality believable web-course concept, readable tactile controls.

assets.purpose: 第四课：同材料同初值，只改变学习率
assets.prompt:
Edit the referenced introductory bench image into experiment4 of the SAME lesson family. Keep the first-person camera, bright lab lighting, tabletop material palette, NOVA header, sample tray and physically grounded instruments. Header “实验 4 · 同起点，比步长”. The familiar bench now has THREE slim matching model cartridges docked into one horizontal comparison rail, all sharing the same six sample cards and the same initial parameters. Treat these as copies of one model for a controlled trial, not three unrelated lessons or dashboard cards.
Clear short caption on a small shared lab strip: “同样样本 · 同样初值 · 只改步长”. The three cartridges have only a small step-size dial and a prediction readout; manual w/b controls are locked during this comparison. Labels “小步 0.005”, “中步 0.025”, “大步 0.08”. A central “同步试验” button and “回到起点” button. Shared input clearly “光照 4 小时”, shared fixed amber reference “5.10”. State after exactly FOUR batch gradient updates, small legend “已学习 4 步”.
Exact blue prediction readouts from left to right: “4.55”, “5.10”, “-1.40”. The big-step cartridge must show a restrained amber warning “超出刻度”; its negative numeric prediction remains visible, do not clip it to0 or make real plants shrink. Real specimen cards and reference stay unchanged.
Each cartridge has a small, physically attached transparent trajectory strip or little relief window. Small-step blue trace approaches slowly; middle-step blue trace approaches the low-loss region; large-step trace crosses back and forth with widening excursions. The paper receipts contain exact small mean squared losses “0.3026”, “0.0167”, “39.8048”, labelled “整组误差”; do not show a fake accuracy percentage or success badge.
Student curiosity is central: a small blank question tab “我猜哪一档更快稳定？” and a nearby real control “暂停看看”. Leave substantial breathing room, make only one condition visually different, maintain a very refined scientific apparatus feeling with tactile dials, transparent sample rails and white ceramic/graphite housings. No clinical room view, no forest, no cute avatars, no gears-only steampunk, no neon cyberpunk, no giant title or marketing interface. All specified Chinese and numeric labels readable. This is a controllable experiment one wants to touch, not a passive graph presentation.

assets.purpose: 可选测量附件：学生发车、采样、训练并验证预测
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the referenced experiment-bench course interface into an OPTIONAL MOTION-MEASUREMENT ATTACHMENT of the SAME chapter5 lesson. Preserve the NOVA header, bright first-person desk camera, inviting daylight, glass/ceramic/brushed-metal housings and blue-model/amber-reference colour language. This should make the student eager to START A REAL SIMULATED EXPERIMENT, collect data and teach the predictor, not just receive prepared data cards.
Header “实验附件 · 预测下一时刻”. A small task strip reads “先发车取样，再让模型学习”. Keep the central two-parameter prediction instrument, but its docked card now says “时刻 4 秒”, not light or plants. Its two dials now read exactly w “1.00”, b “1.00”, with labels “w · 每秒变化” and “b · 起始位置”. The model predicts4*1+1=5.00cm.
Add a beautiful compact STRAIGHT MEASUREMENT TRACK across the foreground of the desk, range0..12cm, a tiny serious silver measurement cart without a face or eyes, physically seated on the rail at position9.00cm. The motion simulator has run to time4.00 seconds; a tiny clock reads “4.00 s”. There is a slim fixed amber optical measuring gate/marker at9cm and a blue model-predicted marker at5cm. The blue marker is a light flag, not another car. Label clearly “模型预测 5.00 cm” and “实测 9.00 cm”, with a visible gap between5 and9. The REAL CART has its own independent motion; turning model dials moves only the BLUE PREDICTED MARK, never the actual cart.
Replace the right plant ruler with a position-comparison ruler labelled “轨道位置 / cm”, showing blue5.00 and amber9.00 on an appropriate0..12scale. No plant photo inside the active ruler. On the left, a small newly printed measurement strip shows exactly three training records “1 s → 3 cm”, “2 s → 5 cm”, “3 s → 7 cm”; caption “我的测量记录”. A separate small sealed box “温室模型 · 已封存” can preserve the previous task, with its sample cards now put away so they do not appear to be inputs to this motion model. The greenhouse and motion models are separate versions.
Four satisfying tactile bench controls “发车取样”, “记录位置”, “学习一步”, “再次验证”. One small blank “我的预测” note for the student. Quiet short note “模型只读取测量记录”. No graphs or formula wall, no fake accuracy scores, no badges, no magical self-steering AI car, no maze, no route-planning board, no cartoons. Keep exquisite educational apparatus quality, realistic functional details and clear numerical relationships. This is a hands-on simulated measuring-and-predicting experiment, not a live hardware controller. All specified Chinese and numeric labels readable.
